description: Creates a Docker daemon connection; docker monitors take the returned ID in their docker_host field. Pass dockerType "socket" with a socket path, or "tcp" with a URL such as http://host:2375 (for example a docker-socket-proxy). The connection is saved without being checked, so call testDockerHost first. To change one use updateDockerHost.

dockerDaemon.description: Unix socket path (e.g. /var/run/docker.sock) when dockerType=socket, or TCP URL (e.g. http://docker-proxy:2375) when dockerType=tcp

dockerType.description: "socket" for a unix socket path, "tcp" for an HTTP/HTTPS URL

name.description: Human-readable name for this docker host

name: createDockerHost
title: Create Docker Host
